newsitem.title: LATVIA: TRASTA TO LAUNCH ANOTHER COMPANY THIS YEAR.
newsitem.headline: TRASTA TO LAUNCH ANOTHER COMPANY THIS YEAR.

text.p: Commercial bank Trasta Bank said on Wednesay that it would place the shares of another private company in the same way that it is issuing those of insurance company Balta.
"We hope that in autumn 1997 and during 1998 several other companies will go a similar way," Trasta vice-chairman Aldis Reims told a news conference.
"At the moment, Trasta is finalising an agreement for placing a new issue with a Latvian company, which will take place in October or November this year," he added.
Trasta is to issue 200,000 shares or 6.5 percent of Balta's share capital.
